prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production 2D game background. Generate a NEW wide landscape 16:9 background for the wish-collage ending of a cozy hand-painted narrative game set in a small old seaside apothecary. Camera nearly straight down over a beautiful warm chestnut writing worktable, orthographic enough that rectangular UI paper and a tray can be laid flat over it without a perspective mismatch. The tabletop fills the entire canvas, no wall, no horizon, no people, no hands. Muted honey chestnut planks, fine varied grain, subtle age, rich painterly gouache and watercolor detail, soft daylight from upper-left, gentle darker corners, comfortable clear reading brightness rather than dark gloom. Composition is functional: left 0-32% completely clear wooden space reserved for the existing open word tray UI; right 35-94% completely clear wooden space reserved for a large decorative letter sheet UI; bottom 10% clear for controls. Tiny atmospheric props confined to extreme outer top/right edges: a small unlabelled dark ink bottle near top-right edge, short length of natural twine, a few delicate dried leaves at very top edge. Keep 85-90% of image clear, calm wood; no objects inside working areas, no large intense grain or sun-stripes beneath the paper. The image should feel intimate, tactile and illustrated, like the painted warm wooden seaside shop with jars and herbs in this project; historical fantasy, restrained and elegant, no modern stationery, no neon, no photorealistic product photography. ABSOLUTELY NO paper sheet, no built-in tray, no word slips, no text, no symbols, no letters, no logo, no buttons, no border. Those will be independent UI elements. Full bleed high-quality standalone background, not a UI screenshot or concept collage.

Use case: stylized-concept, production transparent 2D UI asset. Generate ONE beautiful blank landscape approximately 4:3 letter sheet for a cozy hand-painted seaside apothecary game's wish collage editor. Whole sheet seen directly from above, completely flat, axis aligned, all four corners fully visible, sheet occupying around 91% of canvas with a small transparent margin. GENUINE transparent alpha outside the paper, paper body opaque warm ivory WHITE rather than yellow/brown parchment. Fine softly fibrous cotton paper, restrained deckled natural edges, very subtle wear and faint fold memory, almost smooth bright central writing area. Four corners carry exquisite SMALL hand-painted botanical corner flourishes: tiny cream daisies, blue forget-me-nots, slender muted sage leaves, one or two very thin antique-gold curving lines, airy and tender, not gaudy, not dense. Each flourish stays within outer 12-15% of its corner, very thin light linking flourishes only at edges if needed. Preserve at least central 75% as uninterrupted clean writable space to place movable word slips and a centered UI heading later. No illustration in the center, no writing lines. Match a warm gouache/watercolor storybook game, tactile delicate detail, clear silhouette. NO TEXT AT ALL, no 'I wish', no Chinese text, no handwriting, no signature, no address, no seal, no smiley, no stickers, no desk, no envelope, no hands. No burnt edges, no heavy brown stains, no scroll curls, no rigid metallic frame, no pronounced perspective or big cast shadow. Single usable independent letter-sheet asset with real transparency, not a mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept, production 2D botanical decoration SPRITE ATLAS with GENUINE transparent alpha background. Wide landscape 2:1 canvas, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY EIGHT separate cutout assets in a perfectly regular 4-column by 2-row grid of equal square cells, ONE botanical per cell, centered, all fully contained with at least 12% clear transparent margin in each cell. NO drawn grid, NO labels, NO numbers, NO background. Read order top row left to right: (1) one small white daisy with golden center, short thin stem and two leaves; (2) an airy tiny blue forget-me-not sprig with several blossoms; (3) one slender lavender flowering stem; (4) a curved sage-green leafy sprig with five or six leaves. Bottom row left to right: (5) one delicate fern frond; (6) a single golden wheat stalk with wispy awns; (7) one little buttercup stem with two yellow flowers; (8) one small dusty-pink wildflower on a fine curved stem. These are draggable independent pressed-flower / dried-plant decorations for a heartfelt wish collage in a hand-painted seaside apothecary game. Refined watercolor and gouache, hand-painted fine veins, fragile natural irregularity, soft muted sage, pale blue, dusty lavender, cream and wheat gold. Slightly pressed tactile dried-plant appearance, not dead brown, not thick glossy clip art. Consistent brushwork, resolution, scale and soft neutral illumination. Organic silhouettes WITHOUT any paper sticker backing, WITHOUT white outline, WITHOUT frames, WITHOUT tape. No props, no text, no words, no badges, no overlapping between cells, no cropped petals or stems, no flat opaque backdrop or simulated checkerboard. Each plant is a standalone useful game sprite in its own grid cell; preserve authentic transparent negative space around and within foliage.

botanicalRefinement: Edit this botanical sprite atlas only. Keep the SAME eight plants, four columns by two rows, the same hand-painted pressed-plant style, same palette and details, same order. GENUINE transparent alpha background; absolutely no text, labels, grid lines, checkerboard, desk or decoration. Production-ready transparent cutouts meant to be freely enlarged and rotated on an ivory letter sheet.
